title: 「Following + 名詞片語」表示「在……之後」

source.file: Sentence Structure 192 -「Following + 名詞片語」表示「在……之後」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Following + noun / noun phrase, + complete main clause

formulas.formula: Following + noun / noun phrase, + complete main clause

example: Following the incident, new safety rules were introduced.
exampleZh: 事件發生後，新的安全規則被引入。

examples.en: Following the incident, new safety rules were introduced.
examples.zh: 事件發生後，新的安全規則被引入。
examples.highlight: Following the incident, new safety rules were introduced.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Following + noun / noun phrase, + complete main clause。

rules.zh: Following 在這個句型中表示 after （會議結束後，我們返回辦公室。） 在這個句型中，following 是介詞，意思是「在……之後」。
rules.en: In this structure, following is a preposition meaning after: Following the meeting, we returned to the office.
examples: Following the meeting, we returned to the office.

rules.zh: Following 後面必須接名詞或名詞片語 如原句使用完整子句，通常需要把事件改成名詞片語：
rules.en: Following must be followed by a noun or noun phrase. Correct: Following the meeting, we returned to work. Incorrect: Following the meeting ended, we returned to work. If the source has a full clause, usually turn the event into a noun phrase: After the meeting ended → Following the end of the meeting; After the results were announced → Following the announcement of the results.
examples: Correct: Following the meeting, we returned to work.
Incorrect: Following the meeting ended, we returned to work.
After the meeting ended → Following the end of the meeting
After the results were announced → Following the announcement of the results

rules.zh: 句首片語後要加逗號 當 Following + 名詞片語 放在句首時，片語後面通常要加逗號。
rules.en: Put a comma after an opening Following + noun phrase: Following the inspection, the building reopened.
examples: Following the inspection**,** the building reopened.

rules.zh: Following 主要表示先後次序 Following 本身表示「某事之後」，不一定表示前一件事直接造成後一件事。 （會議結束後，丹尼爾發出了筆記。） 這句只清楚說明事情的先後次序。
rules.en: Following mainly shows sequence. It means that one event happened after another, but it does not necessarily mean the first event caused the second. “Following the meeting, Daniel sent the notes” states the order clearly without claiming causation.
examples: Following the meeting, Daniel sent the notes.

rules.zh: 不要使用 following after Following 本身已包含 after 的意思，因此不需要再加入 after。
rules.en: Do not use following after, because following already contains the meaning of after. Incorrect: Following after the meeting, we returned to work. Correct: Following the meeting, we returned to work.
examples: Incorrect: Following after the meeting, we returned to work.
Correct: Following the meeting, we returned to work.

benefits.zh: 清楚交代事情的先後次序 這個句型能讓讀者立即知道哪件事先發生，以及之後發生了甚麼。
benefits.en: It makes the order of events clear This structure tells the reader which event happened first and what happened afterwards.

benefits.zh: 可以縮短較長的時間子句 你可以把以 after 開始的完整子句改成較簡潔的名詞片語。 兩句意思相同，但第二句更簡潔直接。
benefits.en: It can shorten a longer time clause Instead of using a complete clause beginning with after, you can sometimes use a shorter noun phrase. Compare: After the meeting ended, Daniel sent the notes. Following the meeting, Daniel sent the notes.

benefits.zh: 讓兩件事情自然連接 句首片語先交代背景事件，讓讀者更容易理解接下來發生的事情。
benefits.en: It connects two events smoothly The opening phrase prepares the reader for the event that happened next.

benefits.zh: 增加句首變化 你不需要每句都以主語或 after 開始，因此作文和報告的句式不會過分重複。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to begin a sentence Instead of repeatedly beginning sentences with the subject or with after, you can begin with Following.

benefits.zh: 適合報告、新聞及職場寫作 當你描述事件、決定、巡查、會議、公布或正式程序時，這個句型特別實用。
benefits.en: It is useful in reports, news and workplace writing This structure is common when describing events, decisions, inspections, meetings, announcements and official procedures.
